description: Runs one endpoint by id with parameters and returns its data as compact JSON (source, license, data_freshness included). Bundles answer whole tasks in one call: bundle-location-brief (weather, time, holidays for a place), bundle-country-brief, bundle-eurozone-brief, bundle-energy-brief-de, bundle-npm-package-brief. When to use: you know the endpoint id (from search_apis, from alternatives or catalog_choices of ask_anything, or from the docs) and want to set parameters exactly, e.g. another country or date. params are the endpoint's own query parameters as listed by search_apis (example_query). Unknown ids or bad params return an error message naming the problem. Read-only, no API key or signup. Free quota: 1000 calls/day per IP, shared across tools.

apiId.description: Endpoint id, e.g. fx-currency-convert or bundle-location-brief

fields.description: Optional comma-separated data fields to return (dot paths), saves tokens

full.description: Return the whole answer even above about 2,500 tokens (default false: long lists are shortened)

params.description: Query parameters as key-value map, e.g. {"from":"USD","to":"EUR","amount":"250"}

name: call_api
title: Call an endpoint
